scope: Fitting-unit diagnostics only; no model selection, outer evaluation, or promotion.
phases: Thirds of observed lifetime, derived from labels for evaluation only, never predictors.

quality.flag_rule: Throughput below half of preceding five-discharge median (>=3 prior points), or nonpositive duration/current/throughput. Review only; no rows removed.

source_label_review.note: Post-crossing records of fitting batteries are inspected for label provenance only; never used in model fitting or predictor features. A recovery flag is not proof a label is wrong.
